summary: GEE Group Inc. filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 announcing a supplement to its August 31, 2026 proxy statement postponing its 2026 Annual Meeting from September 24 to September 30, 2026, still virtual via cstproxy.com. No deal, stake, price, premium, or advisor is disclosed. The stated reason is additional time to solicit proxies for the proposals in the proxy statement; the August 10, 2026 record date is unchanged and prior proxies remain valid unless revoked. This is a routine meeting-date change, not a special situation; watch for quorum and vote outcomes on the underlying proposals.
